description: What the dual-mode suite must notice about how the Hub builds the Chat Completions and Responses address from a base URL: a version already in the base (Z.ai ends in /v4) is the provider's own, a segment that only ends in a number or has a word after the number is not a version.

mutations.name: E1
mutations.what: only /v1 counts as a version already in the address (Z.ai ends in /v4)

mutations.name: E2
mutations.what: a segment that only ends in a number (rev2) is taken for a version

mutations.name: E3
mutations.what: a version of two digits (v10) is not one

mutations.name: E4
mutations.what: a version with a word after it (v1beta) is taken for a plain version
